reviews.title: Renewed GPU runs like new
reviews.comment: Got the GPU within a couple of days. Checked it out before install, looked great. Installed it, tested it and it all came back as it should. Always a little worried when I buy something renewed, but I would definitely buy again.
reviews.author: K

reviews.title: Great card for AI stuff, Good price no problems yet.
reviews.comment: Great card for AI stuff, Good price no problems yet. Just enough ram to do most AI stuff. Visions of Chaos is a great program with many AI apps loaded into a single easy to use program. Lots of fun things to do with this card, easily plays anything max graphics.
reviews.author: Anon

reviews.title: Refurbished = Sub Par performance
reviews.comment: Unfortunately for me, I had passed the return windows when I asked AI to show me how to benchmark a graphics card. After multiple test Ai determined the used card was only approaching 70% of what other users reported with a similar setup to mine. I don't think I will take a chance on refurbished products again.
reviews.author: Larry W.

reviews.title: Read my review
reviews.comment: No issues with card no overheating no loud fans no extreme temps etc the thing you need to remember is that this graphics card is case dependent on how you take care of your pc i have no issues with my graphics card I would buy it again
reviews.author: Sean V. Mann

reviews.title: ASUS ROG Strix GeForce RTX 3090 OC Edition 24GB GDDR6X Gaming Graphics Card
reviews.comment: The item works well so far, but there was evident scaring on the PCIe edge connector where someone tried to either take it out or install it improperly before. I understood that I was buying a refurbished card, but I was disappointed in being able to see that kind of damage on the connector.
reviews.author: Jesse Bellew
